recognize_zh: 臨床照片中下排牙齦明顯腫脹增生、呈暗紅至紫紅色，牙齦邊緣肥厚往上覆蓋部分牙冠，呈分葉狀；廣泛性牙齦浸潤是急性骨髓性白血病單核球分化亞型的經典臨床線索。
features: Diffuse swelling and hypertrophy of the mandibular gingiva
Erythematous to violaceous, lobulated gingival margins partly covering the tooth crowns
Involvement of multiple interdental papillae in a continuous band
No obvious ulceration, necrosis, or active bleeding in this view
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the oral cavity shows diffuse hypertrophy of the mandibular gingiva with erythematous to violaceous, lobulated margins that partially cover the crowns of the lower teeth. The enlargement involves multiple interdental papillae in a continuous band, without obvious ulceration or necrosis in this view. Diffuse gingival enlargement of this type in a patient with acute leukemia is consistent with leukemic infiltration, characteristic of AML with monocytic differentiation; bone marrow evaluation with nonspecific esterase and flow cytometry confirms the subtype.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced gingival overgrowth (phenytoin, cyclosporine, calcium channel blockers)
ddx.vs: Drug-induced overgrowth is firm, pink, and fibrotic with a relevant medication history and normal blood counts.
Inflammatory gingivitis shows localized marginal redness and bleeding without diffuse bulky enlargement or leukemic blasts.
Scurvy causes swollen, hemorrhagic gingiva with perifollicular hemorrhages and low vitamin C rather than leukemic infiltration.
GPA shows granular red-purple petechial gingiva with ANCA positivity and granulomatous vasculitis on biopsy.
